Project: Norix Prodigy Bedroom Furniture Series
Your assignment is to review, update, and optimize the remaining Norix Prodigy Bedroom Furniture product pages on the Anchortex Shopify website.
The objective is to improve product descriptions for customers, SEO (Search Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization, including AI-driven search).
We have developed an approved prototype PDP that should serve as your primary example:
Norix Prodigy Anti-Ligature Bed – PRD100 / PRD100B
Use this PDP as a guide for content structure, writing style, formatting, and level of detail. The goal is consistency, but individual products may require different information.
Before editing a PDP, review the product information available from the manufacturer, including its website, catalogs, specifications, and other technical documents.
Correct product name and manufacturer model numbers
Installation and maintenance requirements, where applicable
Manufacturer-supported certifications, testing, and warranty information
Do not invent specifications, certifications, safety claims, or product features.
Do not assume that specifications or certifications for one Norix product apply to another, even within the same furniture series.
When manufacturer information is missing, unclear, or inconsistent, flag it for review rather than guessing.
3. Use AI to Assist with Writing and Editing
You are encouraged to use ChatGPT or another AI tool to help prepare the product descriptions.
Rewrite manufacturer information into clear, professional product descriptions
Draft product titles, subtitles, meta titles, and meta descriptions
When using AI, provide it with the manufacturer information, the approved prototype, and these editorial instructions.
Do not simply accept AI-generated text without reviewing it.
You are responsible for verifying the information, evaluating the writing, and editing the final result.
AI should assist your work, not replace your judgment.
Use the Norix Prodigy Bed PDP as the primary example.
Include the manufacturer, product series, descriptive product name, and model number where appropriate.
Norix Prodigy Anti-Ligature Bed – PRD100 / PRD100B

Its most important benefits or distinguishing characteristics
Important configurations or options, if applicable
Use clear, professional language appropriate for institutional purchasing managers.
Avoid exaggerated marketing claims and unnecessary repetition.

Do not add a separate "Key Features" or "Specifications" heading unless the product requires one for clarity.
Format bullets with a bold label followed by a colon.
Include information relevant to the individual product. Do not add generic specifications simply to make the list longer.
Avoid duplicating features that are already explained adequately in the Prodigy Series section.
If a product has multiple model numbers, configurations, or important options, clearly identify them.
Use a short, bold subheading where appropriate.
For products with only one model and no meaningful options, this section may be omitted.
Describe the environments where the product is intended to be used.
Psychiatric hospitals and inpatient psychiatric units
Do not automatically list every market for every product. Applications must be appropriate to the specific product and supported by the manufacturer information.
Include an appropriate internal link to the relevant Anchortex product collection.
G. About Norix Prodigy Bedroom Furniture Series (H2)

Write primarily for customers who are researching and purchasing institutional furniture.
Use relevant search terms naturally. Depending on the product, these may include:
Do not add keywords that are not relevant to the product.
Use descriptive, accurate product names and headings
Include manufacturer model numbers where relevant

The goal is to make each PDP useful to both customers and search engines, including AI-driven product discovery.
Prepare a meta title and meta description for each PDP.
Include the manufacturer and important product keywords
Keep titles concise, generally aiming for approximately 50–65 characters when practical
Use "at Anchortex" at the end when space permits
Avoid unnecessary punctuation or keyword repetition
Identify the product and its most important benefits or applications
Write natural, useful descriptions that encourage relevant customers to visit the page
Avoid unsupported claims such as "best price" or "safest" unless substantiated
These lengths are guidelines, not absolute limits.
Follow the formatting of the approved prototype.
Use the product title as H1
